'''Andre Rashawd Barrett''' (born February 21, 1982) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Obras Sanitarias]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]]. He played college basketball for the [[Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball|Seton Hall Pirates]].

==Professional career==
Barrett was [[undrafted]] following a [[college basketball]] career at [[Seton Hall University]], and he began his professional career by signing prior to the start of the [[2004–05 NBA season|2004–05 National Basketball Association season]] as a [[free agent]] with the [[New York Knicks]]. He played with the Knicks for three weeks before being waived during the pre-season.<ref>[http://www2.sportsnet.ca/basketball/nba/players/Andre_Barrett/ Andre Barrett - NBA Players - Sportsnet.ca.<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070102125945/http://www2.sportsnet.ca/basketball/nba/players/Andre_Barrett/ |date=January 2, 2007 }}</ref> He then signed with the [[Houston Rockets]], and he later went on to play for the [[Orlando Magic]].

On September 27, 2005, the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] signed Barrett to an undisclosed free agent contract.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/bucks/news/Barrett_Smith_050927.html BUCKS: Bucks Sign Andre Barrett & Tommy Smith.<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> He participated in eight preseason games with the team, however, he was waived prior to the start of the [[2005–06 NBA season|2005–2006 season]] on October 27.<ref>[http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/37704/20051027/bucks_waive_andre_barrett_tommy_smith/ RealGM: Wiretap Archives: Bucks Waive Andre Barrett, Tommy Smith.<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060920190403/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/37704/20051027/bucks_waive_andre_barrett_tommy_smith/ |date=September 20, 2006 }}</ref> Starting on March 1, 2006, Barrett signed two consecutive 10-day contracts with the [[Phoenix Suns]], but he was released from his second contract on March 14. The following day, Barrett signed two consecutive 10-day contracts with the [[Toronto Raptors]], with whom he averaged 15.8 minutes per game. On July 13, 2006, he was waived.

In the 2006 [[NBA Development League|NBA D-League]] Expansion Draft, held on September 25, 2006, the [[Bakersfield Jam]] selected the signing rights to Barrett with their first draft pick.<ref>[http://www.bakersfieldonline.us/news/read/22/93815 One Bakersfield Online - Bakersfield News.<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927163553/http://www.bakersfieldonline.us/news/read/22/93815 |date=September 27, 2007 }}</ref> The previous season, he represented another team from the league, the [[Florida Flame]].

On October 2, 2006, he was signed by the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/bulls/news/training_camp_roster0607.html BULLS: Bulls Announce Training Camp Roster.<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> The following season, on October 22, the Bulls waived Barrett,<ref>[https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/trans;_ylt=AoUp3.pnvpHose1QiUqFTz68vLYF Yahoo! Sports.<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> who then returned to the Jam for the 2007–08 season. On February 25, 2008, he was traded to the D-League club the [[Austin Toros]] in exchange for [[Justin Reed]].

On March 1, 2008, he signed a 10-day contract with the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]]'s [[Los Angeles Clippers]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/clippers/news/barrett_signed_080301.html CLIPPERS: Clippers Sign Guard Andre Barrett<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> When his contract expired, it was not renewed; they signed [[Smush Parker]] instead.<ref>[http://www.latimes.com/sports/la-sp-clippers13mar13,1,7839031.story Clippers fall, sign Parker]</ref>

On August 14, 2008, Barrett signed a 2-year contract with the [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|Spanish ACB League]] club [[FC Barcelona Basquet|FC Barcelona]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/34450/180 FC Barcelona signs playmaker Andre Barrett.]</ref>

On February 5, 2010, Barrett was acquired by the [[Idaho Stampede]] of the NBA D-league.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/stampede_add_guard_andre_barre_2010_02_05.html |title=STAMPEDE ADD GUARD ANDRE BARRETT TO ROSTER |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2013-01-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111125182405/http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/stampede_add_guard_andre_barre_2010_02_05.html |archive-date=2011-11-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In July 2011 he signed with [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] in France.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/france/29830/chorale_roanne_lands_andre_barrett.html |title=Chorale Roanne lands Andre Barrett |access-date=2011-07-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110725014214/http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/france/29830/chorale_roanne_lands_andre_barrett.html |archive-date=2011-07-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On January 4, 2013, Barrett joined the [[Maine Red Claws]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/maine/transaction_010413.html |title=RED CLAWS ACQUIRE ANDRE BARRETT |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2013-01-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150328042856/http://www.nba.com/dleague/maine/transaction_010413.html |archive-date=2015-03-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref> On February 25, 2013, he was traded to the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]].<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130411113320/http://www.nba.com/dleague/siouxfalls/barrett_130225.html|title=Skyforce Acquires Former NBA Point Guard}}</ref>

On October 10, 2013, Barrett signed with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-andre-barrett-131010|title=Grizzlies sign Andre Barrett|date=October 10, 2013|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|access-date=October 11, 2013}}</ref> However, he was waived on October 26.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14656 |title=Memphis Grizzlies waive Andre Barrett, Melvin Ely, Tony Gaffney and Willie Reed |access-date=2013-10-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304053427/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14656 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On October 31, 2014, Barrett's rights were traded from Sioux Falls to the [[Westchester Knicks]] in exchange for a third-round pick and the rights to Brady Morningstar.<ref>[http://www.lohud.com/story/sports/nba/knicks/2014/11/01/westchester-knicks-take-joseph-bertrand-initial-pick/18353025/ Westchester Knicks take Joseph Bertrand with initial pick]</ref> He officially joined the Knicks on November 3, 2014.<ref>[http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=4890587 Westchester Knicks Finalize Inaugural Training Camp Roster]</ref> On April 3, 2015, he was ruled out for the rest of the season after suffering a thumb injury.<ref>[http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=4946467 Westchester Knicks Acquire Kevin Foster]</ref>

On December 22, 2015, Barrett signed with [[Toros de Aragua]] of the [[Liga Profesional de Baloncesto|Venezuelan League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.liderendeportes.com/noticias/baloncesto/toros-anuncia-la-contratacion-de-andre-barrett.aspx|language=es|title=Toros anuncia la contratación de Andre Barrett|work=LiderEnDeportes.com|date=December 22, 2015|access-date=December 25, 2015}}</ref>

On June 27, 2016, Barrett signed in Dominican Republic with the [[Indios de San Francisco de Macorís]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Baloncesto]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Indios de San Francisco anuncian a Andre Barrett como refuerzo|url=http://elnacional.com.do/indios-de-san-francisco-anuncian-a-andre-barrett-como-refuerzo/|access-date=September 3, 2016|work=elnacional.com.do|date=June 27, 2016|language=es}}</ref>

On February 18, 2017, Barrett signed in Argentina with [[Obras Sanitarias]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Andre Barrett llega a Obras|url=http://www.obrasbasket.com/noticias/andre-barrett-llega-a-obras/|access-date=February 20, 2017|work=obrasbasket.com|date=February 18, 2017|language=es}}</ref>
